GitHub profile self-introduction:
Hi there 👋

I'm currently a CS PhD student at Michigan State University. My CV

 Research & Projects

 1. DL Infra, Agent, Long Context Modeling (2026-present)
Currently working on new directions.

 Publications 
 Exploring Cross-Scenario Generality of Agentic Memory Systems: Diagnostics and a Strong Baseline Zhikai Chen , Jialiang Gu, Junyu Yin, Xianxuan Long, Shenglai Zeng, Xiaoze Liu, Kai Guo, Keren Zhou, Jiliang Tang; arXiv 2026
 Do Proactive Agents Really Need an LLM to Decide When to Wake and What to Anchor? Xiaoze Liu, Ruowang Zhang, Amir H. Abdi, Michel Galley, Zhikai Chen , Siheng Xiong, Xiaoqian Wang, Jing Gao; arXiv 2026

 Projects 
 Amadeus: AI-powered research assistant for paper discovery, reading, and analysis
 Slack GPU Monitor: A slack bot to manage your server's GPU.

 Writings 
 A tutorial on DL Infra (Chinese version)
 Notes on optimization

 2. Relational Deep Learning (2025-present)

 OpenRFM: Dissecting Relational In-Context Learning Zhikai Chen , Junyu Yin, Jialiang Gu, Siheng Xiong, Xiaoze Liu, Ruowang Zhang, Keren Zhou, Kai Guo; arXiv 2026
 RFMBench: Towards Principled Benchmarking of Relational Foundation Models.pdf) Zhikai Chen , Han Xie, Jian Zhang, Haiyang Yu, Huzefa Rangwala, Xiang Song; preprint 2026

 A Pre-training Framework for Relational Data with Information-theoretic Principles Quang Truong, Zhikai Chen , Mingxuan Ju, Tong Zhao, Neil Shah, Jiliang Tang, NeurIPS 2025
 Relatron: Automating Relational Machine Learning over Relational Databases, ICLR 2026 Zhikai Chen , Han Xie, Jian Zhang, Jiliang Tang, Xiang Song, Huzefa Rangwala Paper Code

 3. Graph Foundation Models and Large Language Models (2023-2025)

 Note: In the past, I worked on graph foundation models (especially on text-attributed graphs) for a while, these related libraries won't be maintained any more. I personally don't recommend newcomers working on these settings and datasets.

 4. Security and Information Security (2021-2022)

 Projects 
 Fake News Detection

 Publications 
 Leveraging diversity-aware context attention networks for fake news detection on social platforms

 Projects

job.title: Staff Software Engineer
job.description:
Obsidian Security | Staff Software Engineer | REMOTE (US) | Full-time | $176k-$196k + equity + 401k | https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/obsidiansecurity/jobs/51527...
We secure the SaaS apps companies actually run on: M365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. You’d be on the Threat product team working full-stack. That means browser extension code (content/background scripts, manifest v3, message passing), backend services chewing through millions of events, and the data pipelines feeding our detection engine. One day you’re in TypeScript debugging why a content script won’t capture form submissions on some vendor’s weird SPA. The next you’re in Python fixing a Kafka consumer that’s falling behind. Sometimes you’re in Rust optimizing a hot path in the telemetry collector.
Big current focus is shadow AI, i.e. catching when employees paste sensitive data into ChatGPT, Claude, or whatever LLM showed up this week. You’d build the systems that detect it.
Looking for ~8+ yrs experience, real browser knowledge (DOM, event loop, SPA routing, CORS, not just “I used React”), prior browser extension work, strong TypeScript, comfortable in Python, willing to write Rust, plus data-at-scale chops (event streaming, Postgres, Elasticsearch, Kafka). Bonus: AI security (prompt injection, exfiltration), detection engineering/SIEM, or security tooling.
Apply via the link above, or see all our open roles at https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/careers

job.title: Founding Engineer (CTO for the right person)
job.description:
Quin | Founding Engineer (CTO for the right person) | REMOTE (US), preference for Bay Area (tech), Chicago (consumer), or NYC (finance) | Full-time
Quin is an agentic platform to (finally!) solve personal finance for people. It is a consumer-focused company.
https://iamquin.ai
I spent 13 years in private banking and have been working on Quin alone for about 15 months. I built 6 different prototypes to test different approaches. I've spent the last few weeks working with testers on the latest version and solidifying GTM. I need someone to take over engineering with a focus on building the backend and data layers that will support our agentic approach to personal finance.
Georgetown. UCLA (MBA). Ex-JPMorgan.
Traction: Prototype with testers
The role: You're the first engineering hire. This is about shipping the workflows that will become the product that users will trust and the data layer that can support an agent in the future.
You'll own backend architecture decisions from day one. Contract-first development (TypeScript contracts repo as source of truth), FastAPI, Supabase/Postgres, Groq for LLM inference. The stack is clean and the codebase is small.
Who I'm looking for: A full-stack engineer with a preference for backend. 5+ years backend engineering; Python / FastAPI preferred. Strong data modeling instincts — you've designed schemas that had to scale. Experience with multi-tenant data architectures. Comfort operating without process. Finance domain familiarity a plus, not a requirement. Comfort and experience using AI tools and incorporating new ideas quickly.
For the right person, this is an opportunity to take a CTO/co-founder role and define the full technical path.
Comp: Salary post-raise and meaningful equity. TBH, finding this role (either version) will be important for rasisng capital given that I do not have a technical background and fintech is complicated by regulations. I'm ok with part-time in the meantime if that's what it requires.
Email quin@iamquin.ai with the primary reason this interests you and the top two reasons why you should be considered (don't worry about a resume at this point).

job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
Tetsuwan Scientific | Software Engineer | San Francisco (SoMa) | ONSITE | Full-time | $140K–$180K + equity | https://tetsuwan.com
We work with robots that run biology experiments. The robots are accurate, but programming them by hand takes so long that most labs don't bother. So we wrote a compiler and visual editor a scientist can use. They describe their protocol in plain language, we parse it into a structured format, and compile that to optimized code. Our end goal is to build the infrastructure for autonomous science and a centralized cloud lab. Short demo: https://tinyurl.com/mrx63phb
The team is three software engineers, an automation engineer, the founders, and soon a designer. The codebase is one monorepo containing an OCaml compiler, Python backend services, and a TypeScript/React editor. The challenges come in the form of eliciting scientific context and tacit knowledge and in the fact that a protocol has to deterministically run correctly.
We are looking for at least 3 years of experience. OCaml isn't a requirement, just a willingness to learn it. Nice if you've done DSLs, compilers, life sciences or lab automation, an ML-family language, or LLM parsing and evals.
Apply: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/tetsuwan/ad583fec-dc0a-4b6c-8171-41...

job.title: Lead AI Engineer + Agent Builder + Platform Engineer
job.description:
Catalyst·Wayfare AI | Lead AI Engineer + Agent Builder + Platform Engineer | Remote (US) | Full-time / Part-time / Contract | https://catalystwayfare.ai/careers
AI transformation firm shipping production AI systems for mid-market enterprises in regulated and technical domains — finance, energy, industrials, healthcare. We do not stop at PowerPoint AI strategy. We ship working systems alongside our clients' engineering teams. Small teams, deep expertise, real autonomy on real work.
Hiring:
[1] Lead AI Engineer, Agentic Systems — Embedded technical lead on a multi-agent orchestration build for one of the country's leading power engineering firms. Architect the engine; design the patterns we replicate at the next client. 6+ yrs eng, 2+ shipping LLM/agentic systems in production. Strong Python; opinions on agent frameworks. Monthly US travel to one major metro. https://catalystwayfare.ai/jd-lead
[2] AI Engineer, Agent Builder — Hands-on builder embedded on the same engagement. End-to-end ownership of individual capability agents — prompts, tools, retrieval, evals, monitoring. 3–5 yrs strong Python, real production LLM API experience, shipped at least one agent system end-to-end. 1099 contract, ~30–40 hrs/wk. Occasional US travel. https://catalystwayfare.ai/jd-builder
[3]Platform Manager (Engineering), Trust.ML — Founding platform engineer on our productized governance, evaluation, and deployment surface. Own the roadmap, write the code, set the operational posture (SLOs, on-call, audit). 5+ yrs, prior engineer-in-charge experience. Quarterly US travel. Compensation competitive with senior platform roles at venture-funded AI infrastructure companies; equity reflects the founding nature of the seat. https://catalystwayfare.ai/jd-platform
Stack: Claude + OpenAI + Gemini + Perplexity APIs in production, open-source models when the math points there. Cursor and Claude Code daily. Vercel, Neon, Sentry. Evals as first-class artifacts.
Apply: per each JD's instructions, to talent+hn@cwai.co. Short cover note matters more than a resume.

job.title: Forward Deployed Engineer + Senior Applied AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)
job.description:
Puntt AI | Forward Deployed Engineer + Senior Applied AI Engineer (Agentic Systems) | Onsite SF | Full-time
Puntt AI is the system of record for enterprise marketing compliance. Our AI agents turn hours of manual brand and packaging review into minutes of automated precision. Danone, Nestlé, and Kenvue are live customers. The product works. Now we scale.
Forward Deployed Engineer | $190k + equity
https://wellfound.com/l/2CiVyv
The FDE is the person in the room when an enterprise customer shows you their actual broken process. You run discovery, figure out what's really going wrong, configure and ship against it, and bring that signal back to product in a way the team can actually use. You work directly alongside our CEO in live enterprise cycles. What you learn shapes what we build next.
Best fit: solutions engineering, field engineering, or technical founder background. You've been in enterprise rooms, you get to the real problem fast, and you can build the thing that proves the fix. Full stack, AI-native, 7+ years.
Senior Applied AI Engineer | $185k-$210k + 0.75%-1.25% equity
https://wellfound.com/l/2C3WzL
This role owns the agentic core -- multi-agent orchestration, RAG and retrieval, stateful async workflows (Temporal), and the eval frameworks that make compliance AI trustworthy at scale. If you've spent real time thinking about failure modes, observability, and what reliable actually means when LLMs are in the loop, that's who we're looking for.
5-7+ years production engineering. 1-2+ years building with LLMs in real applications. Strong Python. Hands-on RAG.

job.description:
Pelotech | Staff Software Engineer | REMOTE (US Only) | Full-Time
We're Pelotech ( https://www.pelotech.com ), a software consulting company. We are deeply technical but also deeply human: approachable, adaptable, curious, and helpful. We aren't here to blindly build features; we're here to solve problems thoughtfully.
We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer who enjoys working directly with clients, mentoring engineers, and solving messy real-world problems.
You might call yourself a passionate polyglot, versatile specialist, or curious expert. We're looking for engineers with 5+ years of experience, strong backend skills, proficiency in languages such as TypeScript, Go, Python, Java, or Rust, and familiarity with Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, AWS, and GCP.
We value curiosity, pragmatism, kindness, autonomy, and people who enjoy learning new technologies.

job.title: Head of Engineering
job.description:
BIT Capital | Head of Engineering | Berlin, Germany | ONSITE (2 days/week) | Full-time
Looking for the key engineering leader to build and scale infrastructure and data platforms for a Berlin asset management fund. We are betting big on AI to drive investment returns and build the best infrastructure to support our high alpha targets (track record >35% p.a. since inception; https://bitcap.com/en/bit-global-technology-opportunities-ai ...).
You'll design large-scale data pipelines, evolve our lakehouse architecture, strengthen data quality and observability, and build infrastructure for AI/LLM workflows (agentic scaffolding, RAG, LLMOps, AI for engineering). We are looking for a hands-on technical leader, that is steering initiatives end-to-end while staying deep in implementation.
We have our roots in tech entrepreneurship (Jan Beckers), and this mindset still dominates our work culture, even as a regulated financial institution. We are a team of 45 tech- & investment experts with a flat hierarchy, hands-on leadership, fast-paced decisions, and a little nerdy culture as people are actually passionate about their work. Stack: AWS, Databricks/Spark, Python, PostgreSQL, Agentic AI.
If the complexity of financial markets excites you as much as the complexity of distributed systems, you'll love it here. Competitive comp, relocation & visa support, stellar team.
Reach out via: marc.thanhaeuser@bitcap.com
